orders.text:
AO No.465 of 2011 
Hon’ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. I. P. Kohli, the learned counsel for the appellant. 
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, the learned counsel for the respondents - 
claimants. 
Money Withdrawal Application No.12883/2011 filed by the claimants is 
allowed. Interim order dated 02.11.2011 is modified to the extent that Registry is 
directed to remit the amount of Rs.25,000/- to the Tribunal concerned within two 
weeks from today and that 50% of the total amount deposited by the appellant can 
be withdrawn by the claimant without furnishing any security. The balance amount 
shall be deposited by the Tribunal in a fixed deposit, which will be subject to the 
final order passed in the appeal. 
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.) 
Dated 12.12.2011 
LSR
